dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, the FCC, the FTC, the Department of Justice, the registered traceback consortium, voice service providers, marketing businesses, non-profit organizations, and consumers receiving international calls.
dimensions.evidence: Seven representatives of private sector entities, to be appointed as described in paragraph (2)

dimensions.assessment: Changes administrative structures via a temporary task force, grants liability immunity to the trace back consortium, and establishes a bond requirement up to $100,000 for certain providers.
dimensions.evidence: No cause of action shall lie or be maintained in any court against the registered consortium for receiving, sharing, or publishing covered information

dimensions.assessment: Allows existing federal funds from the Commission, FTC, or DOJ to be used for task force coordination, and requires certain voice service providers to post a bond up to $100,000.
dimensions.evidence: funds made available by this or any other Act to the Commission, the Federal Trade Commission, or the Department of Justice may be used

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new temporary interagency task force, amends the Pallone-Thune TRACED Act regarding consortium designations and liability, and adds bond requirements for the Robocall Mitigation Database.
dimensions.evidence: This bill establishes an interagency task force on unlawful robocalls to advise federal agencies and Congress

dimensions.assessment: Includes permanent statutory amendments for consortium designation timing, liability immunity, and database bonds, alongside a temporary task force that terminates 90 days after reporting.
dimensions.evidence: The taskforce shall terminate on the date that is 90 days after the date on which the taskforce submits to Congress the report

missing_information: The exact total dollar amount of federal spending or appropriations for the task force is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill creates an interagency task force on unlawful robocalls, grants liability protections to the tracing consortium, modifies FCC scheduling for consortium designation, and authorizes a robocall mitigation database bond requirement.

latest_action.text: Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 37 - 0.
